$comment: Reviewed exceptions to `npm audit --omit=dev --json`.
A dependency audit gate that is set to a level the current tree already
fails is not a control, it is theatre: either CI is red on the day it is
added, so people ignore it, or it is quietly tuned until it passes, so it
reports safety it is not checking. This file is the alternative — every
accepted advisory is named, with the reason it is accepted, what actually
mitigates it here, who decided, and when it must be looked at again. Anything
NOT listed fails the gate, so a new advisory cannot be absorbed silently and
an accepted one cannot outlive its justification.
Source of truth: `npm audit --omit=dev --json`. See scripts/audit-gate.mjs.
These four were removed in 7f2ceb9 on the strength of a run in which npm
had failed with a configuration error and the gate had parsed the error
envelope as an empty report. The gate now refuses to pass when npm cannot
produce a report at all, and with that fixed these four came back.
Scope, stated so the file is not read as total coverage: the gate runs
`npm audit --json --omit=dev`, so advisories that live only in devDependencies
are not counted here. GitHub Dependabot reports a wider set under its own
source and scope. That difference is a property of the two tools, not
evidence that either is wrong, and the compliance map records it as a limit
rather than resolving it by quietly widening the gate.

exceptions.advisory: memory exhaustion while validating oversized constrained collections
acceptedBecause: The fix is a Zod 3 -> 4 major, which changes the API used across 94 call sites in packages/schemas and the Fastify type provider alongside it. That is a migration, not a bump, and it is not something to absorb while the product is being hardened.

The affected path is unbounded collection validation. Every request collection in this API is explicitly bounded: `evidence_refs` max 20, `action_ids` max 500, policy rule and condition arrays capped in `policySchema`, and `MAX_BODY_BYTES` (1 MiB default, 413 before parsing) limits the whole document. The parser cannot be handed an oversized structure by the network.
The request body is parsed once by the validator compiler and again by the serializer's schema, both against those bounded schemas.
exceptions.residualRisk: A caller that can raise MAX_BODY_BYTES substantially and target a bounded-but-large array of deeply nested objects could cost more memory than its bytes warrant. The body limit is the controlling mitigation; it is a configuration value, so the deployment owner has to keep it honest.
exceptions.compensatingControl: MAX_BODY_BYTES enforced by Fastify before validation (tested in apps/api/test/security.test.ts), and bounded collection schemas (packages/schemas).

exceptions.advisory: inherits the advisory of its zod peer dependency
acceptedBecause: It has no independent fix: the advisory is the transitive zod one above, and the version that resolves it requires the same Zod 4 migration.

exceptions.advisory: arbitrary file read and information disclosure via an attacker-controlled sourceMappingURL in CSS comments
acceptedBecause: The advisory is reached through `next`, which pins its own postcss. Fixing it at the root means a Next major upgrade, and the version that carries the fix is a major whose own release notes change the bundler behaviour this project depends on.

The vulnerable path is CSS PROCESSING of a stylesheet that an attacker would have to get onto the server's disk. PermitZero serves no user-uploaded CSS and no user-supplied stylesheet is compiled at runtime: the console's styles are bundled at build time from this repository.
exceptions.residualRisk: A dependency that lets an attacker write a stylesheet onto the build host, or a future feature that compiles CSS at runtime, would turn this into a file-read primitive. The console is a static bundle today; a user-content rendering path would change that.
exceptions.compensatingControl: No user-supplied CSS is compiled at runtime; the stylesheets are bundled at build time from the repository, and Caddy serves the built asset.

exceptions.advisory: inherits the advisory of its postcss dependency
acceptedBecause: It has no independent fix: the advisory is the transitive postcss one above, and the version that resolves it is a Next major.
